description: This Java source file defines the class RBILoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor, which extends abstract classes related to loan transaction processing. It implements specific logic for handling loan repayment transactions according to RBI (India's) regulations, including interest-first payment logic, handling late payments, advance payments, and refunds within a loan management system.

classes.name: RBILoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
classes.description: A specialized loan repayment transaction processor implementing RBI, India-specific regulations where interest payments are prioritized and handling late/advance transactions accordingly.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the identification code for this repayment strategy.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the descriptive name of the repayment strategy.

methods.name: isInterestFirstRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessor
methods.description: Indicates if this processor handles interest-first repayment logic, returning true.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsPaymentInAdvanceOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles advance payments, currently delegating to on-time payment handling, paying off only the principal component.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsALateRepaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Handles late repayments, paying interest first, then principal, following RBI regulations.

methods.name: nearestInstallment
methods.description: Finds the closest installment based on transaction date, useful for overdue calculations.

methods.name: handleTransactionThatIsOnTimePaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processing normal on-time installment payments, prioritizing interest then principal, with provisions for waivers and charge payments.

methods.name: handleRefundTransactionPaymentOfInstallment
methods.description: Processes refunds on installments, unpaying components in order.
